title: A Life Is Not a Price
style_prompt: Deep cinematic indie soul protest song, intimate clear female vocal, restrained piano and warm bass in the verses, subtle drums building into an anthemic chorus, crisp English diction, emotionally serious but hopeful, no heavy reverb, no melisma on vocabulary words

instruments: live drums with a slow soul pocket
arrangement.arc: Intimate piano-and-bass opening, drums enter in the pre-chorus, full soul arrangement in the chorus, stripped bridge that rebuilds into a final chorus with strings and backing harmonies

vocal.format: female lead with restrained backing harmonies in the final chorus
vocal.timbre: warm human alto with a natural breathy edge
vocal.diction: clear consonants, natural word stress, no melisma on target vocabulary
vocal.delivery: intimate and compassionate in the verses, firm and emotionally expansive in the choruses

words.example: She needs treatment for the pain in her chest.
Commercial interests should not decide who receives care.
Companies advertise their products on television.
The pharmaceutical industry develops and sells medicines.
Rising inflation makes medicine harder to afford.

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Under the clinic light, she waits for treatment
Her hands hold a bill she cannot understand
Outside, a commercial promises salvation
Bright smiling faces say relief is close at hand

sections.name: Pre-Chorus
lines: They advertise a miracle in thirty seconds
But pain does not disappear when the slogan ends

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Treatment should be more than a number in a line
When inflation climbs, a life is not a price
Industry, remember every heartbeat has a name
Keep the commercial, but don't sell hope away
Advertise the truth: no one should stand alone
Treatment is a promise we owe to every home

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: The industry grows taller over quiet streets
Inflation turns tomorrow into borrowed time
A commercial fades, but the waiting room remembers
What they advertise can never measure life

sections.name: Bridge
lines: Let the industry build, but let compassion lead
Let inflation fall before it buries every need
If you advertise a cure, make care the first concern
Let treatment reach the hands that wait their turn

sections.name: Final Chorus
lines: Treatment should be more than a number in a line
When inflation climbs, a life is not a price
Industry, remember every heartbeat has a name
No commercial is worth more than the hope we save
